# Alcantara Safety Solutions

> Alcantara Safety Solutions is a safety plan coordination practice founded and led by Karen Alcantara, a certified safety plan coordinator. The company designs custom workplace safety plans, safe work procedures, hazard and risk assessments, safety manuals, orientation packages, and contractor safety packages — and runs compliance reviews against OSHA and WorkSafeBC regulations for businesses across North America. Positioning: helps companies win contracts, pass inspections, reduce liability, and protect their people.

## Company Facts

- Founder: Karen Alcantara, certified safety plan coordinator (12+ years of experience, 500+ custom safety plans delivered)
- Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada — serving businesses across Canada and the United States
- Contact: (778) 954-1988, karen@alcantarasafety.com, Monday–Friday 8:00am–6:00pm (typical response within one business day)
- Credentials: WorkSafeBC Certificate of Recognition (COR) qualified, NHSA certified, OSHA & WorkSafeBC program specialist, fully insured
- First-time inspection pass rate: 98%

## Services & Pricing

- Custom Safety Plans: $2,500–$7,500, completed in 4–8 weeks (rush delivery in as little as 5 business days). Full hazard assessment, safe work procedures, training matrices, emergency protocols, PPE program, inspection-ready documentation, post-implementation audit. https://www.alcantarasafety.com/safety-plan-creation.html
- Compliance Reviews / Consulting: $1,500–$5,000. Regulation-by-regulation gap analysis (OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1926, WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation), documentation audit, mock inspection, prioritized corrective action plan, citation response support. https://www.alcantarasafety.com/compliance-consulting.html
- Hazard & Risk Assessments: $1,200–$4,000. One to two days on site. Scored risk register, photo-documented findings, worker interviews, controls ranked by the hierarchy of controls. https://www.alcantarasafety.com/risk-assessments.html
- Safe Work Procedures: plain-language, step-by-step procedures for high-risk tasks.
- Safety Manuals & Orientation Packages: complete health and safety manuals plus new-hire onboarding packages.
- Contractor Safety Packages: COR-ready documentation and pre-qualification packages to satisfy clients before work begins.
- Safety Audits & COR Preparation: comprehensive audits scored against WorkSafeBC OHS Regulation requirements, corrective action plans, guided Certificate of Recognition audit preparation.
- Confined Space Programs: hazard identification, entry procedures, atmospheric testing protocols, and rescue plan development.
- Infection Prevention & Control (IPAC): exposure control plans, hygiene and sanitation protocols, staff procedures.
- Ongoing Safety Coordination: monthly support, annual reviews, plan updates, refresher training.
- Services hub: https://www.alcantarasafety.com/services.html

## Process (5 Steps)

1. Book a free consultation (15 minutes)
2. Needs assessment: industry, employees, equipment, risks, compliance requirements
3. Custom plan build — never copied from templates
4. Review together — every section explained
5. Stay protected — updates as the business grows and regulations change

## WorkSafeBC Alignment

All safety plans are built around WorkSafeBC's published guidance for developing a health and safety program: signed health and safety policy, regular workplace inspections, written safe work procedures for high-risk tasks, worker orientation, education and training, joint committee or worker health and safety representative, incident investigations (including immediate reporting of serious incidents), record-keeping (program reviews, orientation records, inspection reports, meeting records, investigation reports, first aid records), and an annual program review against the OHS Regulation.
